tex_content.html:
Definition
[exterior derivative via the covariant derivative]

Source: petersen:page-0078, petersen:page-0079 ↗ def:pet-ch2-covariant-derivative-tensor

For a $k$-form $\omega $, $(d\omega )(X_0,\dots ,X_k)=\sum _i(-1)^i( abla _{X_i}\omega )(X_0,\dots ,\hat X_i,\dots ,X_k)$. More generally, for a $(1,k)$-tensor $T$ skew-symmetric in its $k$ covariant slots, define the $(1,k+1)$-tensor $(d^ abla T)(X_0,\dots ,X_k)=\sum _i(-1)^i( abla _{X_i}T)(X_0,\dots ,\hat X_i,\dots ,X_k)$; for $k=0$, $T=Y$ a vector field, $(d^ abla Y)(X)= abla _XY$; for $k=1$, \[ (d^ abla T)(X,Y)=( abla _XT)(Y)-( abla _YT)(X) = abla _X(T(Y))- abla _Y(T(X))-T([X,Y]). \]
